name: I have to keep going for big sis

mapping.evidence: Three repeated opposing clash flashes with enemy lunges, followed by one unilateral sweeping strike. Fits supplied one-coin clashable counter; UI hidden. Small earlier ignition may be combat-start fuel activation.

weapon.type: bulky forearm-mounted mechanical fist/flamethrower gauntlet with backpack and flexible hoses
weapon.size_relative_to_body_height: forearm assembly ~0.35–0.5 H long, ~0.2 H thick; backpack ~0.6 H tall
weapon.held: worn on one forearm, aimed/punched one-handed; opposite arm balances; not shouldered and not a two-handed gun
weapon.parts_and_colors: segmented bronze/olive plates #75613B, dark metal #302D24, black hoses #18191A, dark tank pack #292B24; orange ignition #FF8A00 at hand
weapon.evidence: 36.733–36.900 and 40.000–40.100 extended device with backpack hose loop; 56.900 one-frame close-up of plated mechanism; details.jpg
weapon.confidence: high for arm-mounted device, medium for mechanical parts hidden by sprite scale

caster_motion.description: Raise lit arm then lower into braced stance.
Mostly planted; short arm swings/recoils during clashes. Enemy repeatedly closes ~1–2 H.
Sweep, settle and hold until hard cut.

hits.evidence: Final strike occurs after enemy withdraws; starburst visible at right 52.533. Unlike earlier clash flashes, camera follows Gregor forward.
hits.coin_assignment: inferred from grouped animation and supplied kit; no visible combat UI

beats.description: Enemy approaches and waits at close range.
Clash 1 white X flash, fire sweep and orange loop; opponent recoils.
Clash 2 white X, orange ring/fire thrust.
Clash 3 white X and orange ring; enemy retreats farther.
Forward rush and horizontal fire sweep.
One counter contact, embers, recovery and arena cut.

camera.framing: Cut closer to raised gauntlet, then ease back.
Hold both fighters for three clash exchanges; mild zoom breathing.
Follow Gregor right; target initially cropped.
Contact bloom right, then settle before cut.

camera_baseline: Side-on 2.5D battle plane, caster left facing right, target right facing left. Slight elevated view of floor. Reproduce with locked yaw and short dolly/pan changes, not orbiting camera. Gold border and subtitles are presentation overlays.
limitations: Frame numbers identify visible changes, not hidden game damage ticks. Occluded contacts have explicit uncertainty. Coin groupings are hypotheses without UI. Noncombat montage transitions reviewed at 6 fps have up to 5-frame uncertainty.

H = standing caster body height in the same shot, excluding VFX. Distances are approximate projected centre-to-centre separation, not calibrated 3D distances. Camera zoom/knockback is not caster travel. Hex colours are visual approximations, not sampled material colours.

clashes_not_damage_coins.observation: White crossing flare between fighters, followed by crescent and enemy red recoil; candidate clash 1.
White crossing flare after enemy re-approach; candidate clash 2.
Third white crossing flare, enemy then withdraws.

coin_count_comparison: 1 grouped damage events / 1 kit coins; grouping is inferred, not combat-UI verified
